name: fusion-orchestrator
description: Fusion model-routing orchestration: frontier lead plans a packet, a middle manager audits and dispatches model-pinned workers, provenance attested from execution receipts.

interface.shortDescription: Model-pinned subagent teams with attested provenance
interface.longDescription: Fusion decomposes one goal into a team of model-pinned subagents. A frontier lead plans a validated packet; a middle manager audits each worker prompt (hard gate against prescription), dispatches one bounded task per member, and collects artifacts. Provenance is attested from harness.json receipts - what actually ran, never the roster.
